about: The Mac App Store listing for Ouro MD, staged by spoonjoy/spoonjoy-apple's stager (scripts/stage-app-store-listing.rb --platform MAC_OS) with the frames Store scenes renders. versionString stays on the record's editable version until a new build is submitted. Price, availability, age rating, categories and content rights are left out on purpose: they are set in App Store Connect and never changed by staging.

review.notes: Review path: No account or sample login is required. Create or open a Markdown file, then use Shift-Command-O to open a folder. Use the File Tree, Outline, and Search sidebars; open the Command Palette with Shift-Command-P; switch themes; export PDF or HTML from the File menu. The App Store build has direct-download updates and telemetry disabled.

en-US.name: Ouro MD
en-US.subtitle: Local Markdown Workspace
en-US.description:
Ouro MD is a Markdown editor for the Mac, made for reading the files you and your AI agents write, and editing them in place.

READ IT LIKE A PAGE
Type Markdown and it renders where you type, on a centered page set in book-like type. Headings, tables, task lists, code, math, footnotes and diagrams all render in place. The # and * marks stay on the page, faint enough to read past and still there to edit. Want the raw text? Source and Split modes are one keystroke away.

SEE WHAT CHANGED
Leave a note in the file, let your agent revise it, and keep reading. When the file changes on disk, Ouro MD marks the passages that changed and keeps your place on the page, so you check the new words instead of rereading the old ones.

YOUR FILES, YOUR FOLDERS
Ouro MD opens the Markdown files you already keep in Finder. Open a folder to browse it in the File Tree, follow a long document in the Outline, and search every file in the folder. There's no account and nothing is hosted. Your files stay where you put them.

FOUR THEMES
Quartz is for daylight and Graphite is for late nights. Manuscript sets your text in a warm serif, and Newsprint in tight editorial type. Switch while you read, or bring your own CSS.

MADE FOR THE KEYBOARD
Shift-Command-P opens the command palette. Type a few letters to reach export, themes, modes, headings or tables. Focus mode dims every paragraph except the one you're in, and Typewriter mode keeps your line in the middle of the window.

SHARE IT FINISHED
Export a self-contained HTML file or a PDF in your theme, or print with page margins, footnoted links and page breaks before the headings you choose. Printing and exporting never touch your Markdown.

Ouro MD is free, with no ads and no in-app purchases.
en-US.promotionalText: Your agent rewrote the file while you were reading it. Ouro MD marks the passages that changed and keeps your place, so you only reread what's new.
